title: Drone-IDS
summary: A drone intrusion-detection system project that simulates ArduPilot/MAVLink flights (normal and attack) and parses telemetry logs into CSV datasets for IDS training. Its generate_synthetic.ipynb notebook uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to fit on real attack telemetry and generate synthetic attack samples for augmenting the training data.
evidence: generate_synthetic.ipynb:160 'synthesizer = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, epochs=300, verbose=True)' then synthesizer.fit(real_attacks_df)
